facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation (MICSTI), with UNDP and Norway Registers Development, produced a second draft of a Data Management Policy and Implementation Plan for the Government of Lesotho, a 40-page draft for which the document gives no date, so the 2025-01-21 publication date is used.

slug: 2026-03-23 Reassessing the role of data protection authorities in Africa
note: Regional article; its only Lesotho statement is that the 2011 Data Protection Act's Commission is unappointed, which is data protection, not a national data policy.

facts.fact: MICSTI's ICT Director, Khiba Masiu, said the Ministry is on the verge of finalising a Data Management Policy, reported by the Lesotho News Agency on 2026-02-20, so it was still unadopted.

MICSTI with AUDA-NEPAD, GIZ and CIPESA held a one-and-a-half-day validation workshop on 13 October 2025 to align Lesotho's draft Data Management Policy with the African Union Data Policy Framework and build consensus on it; the page was published 2025-10-14.

The Lesotho Times reported that a national validation workshop in Maseru, convened by the Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation with Smart Africa and GIZ, reviewed the draft Data Value Creation Blueprint, which is expected to give Lesotho a coordinated national approach to data governance; the date is the article's publication date, as it says only 'this week'.

note: No body or rule is tied to the blueprint.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation submitted a draft National Data Value Creation Blueprint to a validation workshop in Maseru, to review its vision, theory of change, strategic pillars and ecosystem diagnostic; the date is the publication date, as the account gives none.

note: No body or rule is tied to the blueprint.

facts.fact: The Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation hosted the first national stakeholder consultative workshop on developing the National Data Value Creation Blueprint in Maseru, under the Smart Africa programme (the document's note dates the workshop 14-15 July 2026).

note: Only the start of drafting; no body or rule.

facts.fact: The Lesotho Times reported that the Minister of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation officially signed the Data Management Policy, which sets a framework for data governance, privacy, security and ethical use, at a ceremony in Maseru 'yesterday' (11 June 2026), the day before the article.

note: No body or rule is named.

facts.fact: The Minister of Finance and Development Planning told Parliament on 19 February 2025 that key policies under development include Artificial Intelligence, Broadband and Data Management; the date is the speech's.

note: Speech names the policy as under development only; no body or rule.
